note: in truth (often tends to intensify)。**注意它是强调词，不只是「确认」**：It is indeed cold. 意为「确实冷」。线索：indeed / and indeed（甚至可以说）。

glossEn: (used as an interjection) an expression of surprise or skepticism or irony etc.
note: (used as an interjection) an expression of surprise or skepticism。独立成句。线索：Indeed? 你可真行！现有中文无此义项，属新增 —— 这是本词唯一的非副词用法。
